tasks.short: Assess performance demands for rehabilitation exercise

steps.what: Obtain and capture the person's actual activity demands, recovery goals and relevant restrictions from the referral, interview and physical observations
Assess physical performance requirements and their relation to individual recovery or rehabilitation exercise, considering contraindications, capacity and uncertainty
Write and check the final performance assessment in the clinical-record category of {OTHER}; reuse only patient, referral and measurement headers
Commit the exact checked assessment note in the clinical-record category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Test native assessment-note header reuse in the clinical-record category of {OTHER}. The physiologist captures actual performance evidence, makes the individual assessment and checks the completed note before committing it; no software sets exercise requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Referral and measurement identifiers may be re-entered in assessment notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing encounter fields can populate note headers deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Actual demands, capacity and recovery constraints require professional assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist relates observed performance to the person's real goals and limitations.
tasks.altitude: A small documentation reduction, unchanged assessment responsibility.

reach.learn: Distinguish an observed limitation from an assumed activity demand.

evidence.claim: Clinical record headers can reuse existing encounter fields without generating an assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is performance-demand assessment and its note, excluding exercise prescription and other clinicians' work. The clinical-record category of {OTHER} is used in all clinical steps.

The referral producer supplies patient ID, referral ID and stated restrictions. The physiologist obtains actual activity, goal, observed measure, unit, date and limitation in s1; all capture and checking are counted. Missing data are clarified manually, never inferred from a scheduled assessment.

Native header reuse is tested first. Shares are illustrative, not measured. Final s3 checking follows completed clinical wording and binds the exact patient and encounter; edits void the commit approval.
unknowns: Which assessment measures are routinely recorded
research_questions: Is repeated header entry a real part of assessment documentation?

already_counted.description: Actual clinical note writing and final checking remain in s3.

incremental.description: Check header mappings after record-system changes.

approvals.approved_version: Final patient-specific assessment note checked in s3; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Header reuse saves 1.4 gross less 0.4 upkeep for 1 net. Existing native reuse gives zero gain; assessment, actual capture and commit keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the approved session plan and each group's current restrictions and check participants' readiness before exercise
Teach group exercise to low-, medium- or high-risk clients, demonstrate movements and monitor actual responses while adapting within professional authority
Enter and check actual attendance, responses and significant deviations in the existing session-record category of {OTHER}
Save the exact checked actual session entry in the session-record category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Keep risk review, live exercise teaching and actual session capture in the existing session-record category of {OTHER}. After splitting out record writing and saving, no duplicate entry or safe change to supervision is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe instruction depends on participants' actual condition and response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing session forms support capture but no further time-saving change is demonstrated.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected symptoms and movement quality need immediate professional attention.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist notices a participant who needs to slow down or stop.

ambition.what: No expanded clinical authority or unattended group.

reach.learn: Follow the existing escalation procedure and report observed facts.

evidence.claim: Group exercise supervision depends on actual participant responses rather than scheduled participation.

assumptions: Boundary is supervised group teaching and its ordinary session entry, excluding prior programme design and emergency care. No saving in participant or other-clinician work is claimed.

Existing clinical or session records supply the approved plan and current restrictions. The physiologist establishes actual attendance and observes responses in s1-s2 and captures participant ID, session date, attendance, response and deviation in s3. Missing information is clarified manually; planned attendance is not completion.

This scenario assumes an existing native session form, not a newly invented report. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. The ordinary final entry check in s3 binds the exact actual record before saving. No new tool means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Which session fields are already recorded natively
research_questions: Is there actual duplicate session capture to remove?

already_counted.description: Actual record writing and checking remain in s3.

incremental.description: No new tool or procedure; zero additional upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: Actual post-session record checked in s3; edits void the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Risk review, teaching, actual response capture and saving are separately counted and unchanged; no duplicate-entry or supervision saving is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach stress-management or weight-control behaviour classes

steps.what: Prepare behaviour modification classes on stress management or weight control; select vetted exercises and write class prompts in {DOCS}, reusing approved worksheet layouts
Teach the behaviour modification class, discuss practical barriers and support participants without treating the class as individual diagnosis or prescribing
Write and check actual class participation and necessary follow-up in the session-record category of {OTHER}
Save the exact checked behaviour-class record in the session-record category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Test native approved worksheet layouts in {DOCS} to reduce repeated preparation formatting. The physiologist selects the material, teaches behaviour skills and captures actual class follow-up in the existing session record; no model infers a participant's motivation or health.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated worksheet layout can accompany each class preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved reusable document structures can reduce that formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Stress, readiness to change and personal barriers need sensitive conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist adapts explanation without judging a person's motivation from data.

ambition.what: No new counselling or prescribing authority.

tasks.altitude: Less worksheet setup, unchanged participant support.

reach.task: Provide individual dietary advice when needed
reach.learn: Recognise the boundary between general education and individual care.

evidence.claim: Reusable approved worksheet layouts can reduce repeated document setup without replacing teaching judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is group behaviour teaching with ordinary session documentation, not individual diagnosis or individual diet prescription. Reusable materials are delivered during teaching, with no separately assumed electronic send.

The responsible clinical education team supplies vetted text, version and layout. The physiologist chooses actual topics and writes prompts in s1, observes the actual class in s2 and records session ID, date, participation and necessary follow-up in s3. Missing material or context requires manual preparation; planned participation never becomes an actual record.

Native configuration first. Shares are an illustrative repeated-class scenario, not measured baseline. The normal final s3 check binds the completed record before saving; no new approval layer is added.
unknowns: How much worksheet preparation already uses native templates
research_questions: Do approved layouts remove repeated setup in actual behaviour classes?

already_counted.description: Material selection, actual prompts and worksheet checking remain in s1.

incremental.description: Maintain approved worksheet versions and remove obsolete material.

approvals.approved_version: Actual behaviour-class record checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated worksheet setup saves 5 gross hours less 1 upkeep for 4 net. Existing approved layouts give zero benefit. Teaching, actual record capture and saving retain their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish whether the audience is patients, athletes or a community group and select appropriate vetted exercise or diet education within professional scope
Prepare and check the final course or seminar slides and handout in {DOCS}, adapting actual explanations while native styles reuse layout and source fields; check audience and recipient
Send the exact checked seminar handout to the checked organiser or audience through {EMAIL}
Teach the course or seminar related to exercise or diet, demonstrate principles and respond to actual audience questions within professional scope

tasks.design: Test native education layouts and source fields in {DOCS}. The physiologist chooses audience-appropriate vetted material and checks the completed handout before sending it, then teaches and answers questions personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific seminars can repeat layout and source formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document styles can reuse approved structure without creating individual advice.
tasks.still_hard: Audience understanding and the boundary of individual care require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physiologist recognises when a question needs a personal clinical consultation instead of a general answer.

ambition.what: No new service or clinical authority.

tasks.altitude: Less seminar format setup, unchanged teaching responsibility.

reach.task: Match educational material to audience needs
reach.learn: Check reading level and scope without diluting important caveats.

evidence.claim: Native education layouts can reuse structure while actual health explanations remain professionally selected and checked.

assumptions: Boundary is a general course or seminar with a handout, excluding clinical assessment, individual prescription and event administration. This is a separate educational engagement from the behaviour and exercise classes above, not duplicated delivery.

The organiser supplies audience, topic, date and intended recipient. The education owner supplies vetted text and version; the physiologist reads, chooses and adapts it in s1-s2 including source capture. Missing or outdated sources require manual resolution, never generated medical claims.

Native configuration first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. The ordinary final s2 check occurs after the full handout exists and binds its exact content and recipient; changes require rechecking. No extra document save baseline is invented.
unknowns: Whether standard seminar layouts already exist
research_questions: What repeated format work remains in actual seminar preparation?

already_counted.description: Actual material adaptation and final audience and source checks remain in s2.

incremental.description: Keep education styles linked to current approved sources.

approvals.approved_version: Completed seminar handout and recipient checked in s2; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated formatting saves 6 gross hours less 1 upkeep for 5 net. Existing native layouts give no benefit. Source choice, clinical meaning, teaching and handout send remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated formats can shrink while assessment and live participant supervision retain professional control.
reach: Coordinate with physical therapists, nurses and dietitians within scope.
role.ambitious_version: A physiologist who spends less time on repeated formats while keeping actual patient and participant responses central.
